spans.s:
स्मेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
 1. Smiling, laughing.
 2. Blown, opened, expanded,
(as a flower.)
 3. Evident, apparent.
 m. (-रः) Manifestation,
appearance.
 E. ष्मि to smile, रन् aff.

स्मेरमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Having a smiling look.
 E. स्मेर, and मुख face.

स्मेरविष्किर m. (-रः) A peacock.
 E. स्मेर smiling, विष्किर a bird.
